title: Q74 solution: the 10-second integral (format test day 2)

captions.instagram:
Yesterday's 10-second challenge: here's the trick 👇

NDA 2026 (II) · Maths · Q74. It looks like a monster integral, but it's a 10-second question.

The trick: before you integrate, check whether the integrand is the derivative of something.
d/dx (xˣ) = xˣ(1 + ln x), so the answer is just [xˣ] from 1 to 2 = 4 − 1 = 3 → (b).
